name: prose-forbids-graph-state-reads
body:
The distributed agents' File-access prose must plainly forbid direct reads of graph-state files. In each of `spec-review.md`, `spec-writer.md`, `plan-writer.md`, `plan-review.md` the `## File access (strict)` section must describe the durable spec node files and the transient plan/feedback stores (in prose, without their filesystem paths — domain.constraint.no-internals-in-prose) as things the agent must NEVER read directly, and must name the apg tools (`apg_query`, `apg_review`, `apg_plan_*`, `apg_node`/`apg_edge`) as the only interface that reaches them.

Acceptance: after the change no File-access section carries an unqualified "you may read any file" claim; each states the never-read-directly rule; and reading ordinary source files behind code FQNs with `read` remains explicitly allowed.
